newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Northwest Pipe estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Northwest Pipe estimate cut.

text.p: -- Hanifen Imhoff Inc said Friday it lowered its earnings estimate for Northwest Pipe Co for fiscal 1997 to $1.80 from $1.95 to reflect the impact of project bidding levels and a new Tubular mill coming on line in Portland in the second half of the year.

-- The company reported first-quarter earnings of $0.37 a share, versus $0.50 a year ago, in spite of a 22-percent increase in sales to $37.8 million, Hanifen said. The results reflect lower margins, especially in the Water Transmission segment, as well start-up losses at the recently acquired Riverside facility, Hanifen said.
-- Northwest Pipe makes large-diameter welded steel pipe for water transmission among other products.
-- Its shares were off 1/4 Friday afternoon at 15-1/2.
